sentences.text: Titanic is a 1997 American epic romance-disaster film directed , written , co-produced , and co-edited by James Cameron .	James Cameron	James Cameron	epic	epic film	romance	romance film	disaster film	disaster film

A fictionalized account of the sinking of the RMS Titanic , it stars Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet as members of different social classes who fall in love aboard the ship during its ill-fated maiden voyage .	Leonardo DiCaprio	Leonardo DiCaprio	Kate Winslet	Kate Winslet	sinking	Sinking of the RMS Titanic	maiden voyage	maiden voyage

Cameron 's inspiration for the film came from his fascination with shipwrecks ; he felt a love story interspersed with the human loss would be essential to convey the emotional impact of the disaster .
Production began in 1995 , when Cameron shot footage of the actual Titanic wreck .

The modern scenes on the research vessel were shot on board the Akademik Mstislav Keldysh , which Cameron had used as a base when filming the wreck .	Akademik Mstislav Keldysh	Akademik Mstislav Keldysh

Upon its release on December 19 , 1997 , Titanic achieved critical and commercial success .
